frameworks.core_paradigm_zh: 基于 Cordis 微内核的“万物皆插件 (Everything Is a Plugin)”与三角色能力缝隙 (Capability Seams) 运行时
frameworks.core_paradigm_en: Cordis Microkernel 'Everything Is a Plugin' & 3-Role Capability Seam Runtime

frameworks.core_paradigm_zh: 端到端垂直整合的原生终端/SDK 自主循环、读写并发分级与三层渐进式上下文压缩
frameworks.core_paradigm_en: Vertically Integrated Native Terminal/SDK Loop, Read/Write Concurrency Tiers & 3-Tier Context Compaction

frameworks.core_paradigm_zh: 约定优于配置 (Convention-over-Configuration) 的四层 AI 工件委托链与 RPI 磁盘状态隔离工程体系
frameworks.core_paradigm_en: Convention-over-Configuration 4-Tier AI Artifact Delegation & RPI Disk-Backed Context Reset Harness

layers.dsh_mechanism: Cordis IoC kernel (Services + emit/serial/waterfall Events + Disposers); 4-stage bundle/patch loader
layers.claude_code_mechanism: Bundled native CLI/SDK binary + .claude-plugin marketplace + settings.json + MCP servers
layers.hve_mechanism: collections/*.collection.yml -> Generate-Plugins.ps1 -> VS Code Extension & Copilot CLI plugins

layers.layer_name_zh: Turn/Step 认知循环与状态机
layers.dsh_mechanism: Replaceable dsh-agent-loop (ReactLoopAgent + ReactLoopInbox splice events + prepareCall freeze)
layers.claude_code_mechanism: QueryEngine stream loop (SystemMessage init -> AssistantMessage/UserMessage -> ResultMessage + budget cap)
layers.hve_mechanism: Phase-isolated RPI state machine (Uncertainty -> Knowledge -> Strategy -> Working Code -> Validated Code)

layers.layer_name_zh: 工具执行管线与并发调度
layers.dsh_mechanism: 7-stage guarded waterfall (pre-execute -> approval -> guards -> execute -> projectContent -> post-execute) + Native & PTC run_code
layers.claude_code_mechanism: Read-only concurrent batching (readOnlyHint) + Stateful serial barrier (Edit/Write/Bash) + 6 permission modes
layers.hve_mechanism: Declarative tools[] frontmatter scoping + ValLy eval safety lint + PowerShell/Bash skill scripts

layers.layer_name_zh: 上下文工程与压缩防退化
layers.dsh_mechanism: Ordered systemPrompt fragments + in-history prompt append (KV cache safe) + toolResultPruner + surfaceOp replace
layers.claude_code_mechanism: Prompt-cached CLAUDE.md + ToolSearch lazy schema deferral + PreCompact hook + compact_boundary auto-summary
layers.hve_mechanism: Explicit /clear between RPI phases + .copilot-tracking/ deterministic disk artifacts + applyTo glob instructions

layers.layer_name_zh: 会话事件溯源与持久化恢复
layers.dsh_mechanism: Append-only SessionEventMap log ('model-visible means logged') + deriveMessages() projection + crash closer repair
layers.claude_code_mechanism: JSONL local transcript + Dual-write sessionStore adapter for stateless containers + session fork/resume
layers.hve_mechanism: Git-auditable .copilot-tracking/ markdown artifacts (research, plans, details, changes, reviews)

layers.layer_name_zh: 子智能体与多智能体协同
layers.dsh_mechanism: 7 pluggable ctx.subagents backends (in-process spawn/fork, ACP, Claude Code, Codex, DSH SDK) + Agent Teams CAS DAG board
layers.claude_code_mechanism: Agent tool isolated context windows + effort override + shared max_budget_usd enforcement + git worktree isolation

layers.layer_name_zh: 能力缝隙与远程沙箱解耦
layers.dsh_mechanism: 3-Role Seam (Service Definition / Provider / Consumer): swap ctx.fs & ctx.subprocess to SSH/container without tool forks
layers.claude_code_mechanism: Devcontainer + egress-firewall.yaml + AWS/GCP gateway Terraform + settings-bash-sandbox / HIPAA templates
layers.hve_mechanism: Devcontainer lockfile validation + MCP server wiring (.vscode/mcp.json) + GitHub Actions workflow hardening

layers.layer_name_zh: 软件工程治理与评测门禁
layers.dsh_mechanism: Contract unit tests + PtcDispatchLog policy auditing + schema validation across 411 packages
layers.claude_code_mechanism: MDM policy templates (macOS plist / Windows ADMX) + PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks + workflow hardening checks
layers.hve_mechanism: Vally eval suites (skill-quality, agent-behavior, baseline-equivalence) + Planner artifact signing + model catalog lint

tiers.label_zh: Tier 2 · 6 读 + 2 写屏障 (Read×6 -> Edit -> Bash)
tiers.label_en: Tier 2 · 6 Reads + 2 Mutating Barriers (Read×6 -> Edit -> Bash)

tiers.label_zh: Tier 3 · 20 步跨模块依赖追踪与 AST 过滤
Tier 4 · 50 次工具调用批量迁移 (受限于 PTC 2048 配额门禁)
tiers.label_en: Tier 4 · 50-Call Batch Migration (Guarded by PTC 2048 Cap)

scenarios.question_zh: 在不分叉 Bash/LSP/Read 工具代码的前提下，将执行从本地迁移到远程 SSH/容器沙箱
scenarios.question_en: Move Bash/LSP/File execution from local host to remote SSH/Container sandbox without forking tools
scenarios.recommended_pattern: DeepSeek DSH (3-Role Capability Seams: ctx.fs + ctx.subprocess)
scenarios.rationale_zh: DSH 将 Service Definition、Service Provider 与 Tool Consumer 解耦，仅替换 provider 插件即可迁移全部工具。
scenarios.rationale_en: DSH decouples Service Definition, Provider, and Tool Consumer; swapping provider plugins migrates all tools transparently.

scenarios.question_zh: 防止编码智能体在 200K Token 后因近因偏差 (Recency Bias, 1.5% 权重) 跳过规划与验证直接改代码
scenarios.question_en: Prevent coding agents from skipping planning/review after 200K tokens due to 1.5% instruction recency dilution
scenarios.recommended_pattern: Microsoft HVE Core (Strict RPI + /clear + .copilot-tracking/ disk artifacts)
scenarios.rationale_zh: HVE 强制阶段间 /clear 并通过 .copilot-tracking/ 磁盘工件传递确定性状态，将指令有效权重维持在 15%+。
scenarios.rationale_en: HVE enforces inter-phase /clear and passes deterministic state via .copilot-tracking/ disk files, keeping instruction share >=15%.

scenarios.domain_zh: 高频多步工具编排与 Token 降噪
scenarios.question_zh: 单任务需执行 30+ 次文件检索与 JSON 聚合，需避免中间结果撑爆上下文并降低模型往返延迟
scenarios.question_en: Execute 30+ file lookups and JSON aggregations without polluting context history or incurring 10+ model round-trips
scenarios.rationale_zh: PTC 模式通过 run_code TypeScript 沙箱一次性编排 Promise.all 子调用，中间变量留在本地内存，仅最终 return 进入会话。
scenarios.rationale_en: PTC mode orchestrates Promise.all subcalls inside a single run_code program; intermediate values stay local outside session history.

scenarios.domain_zh: 终端研发流与CI成本硬门禁
scenarios.domain_en: CLI Dev Loop with Hard USD Budget Cap
scenarios.question_zh: 在研发终端与 CI 中嵌入自主修复循环，要求对主 Agent 与全部后台子 Agent 实施统一美元预算硬上限
scenarios.question_en: Embed autonomous test-fix loop in CLI/CI with a strict shared USD spend ceiling across parent and subagents
scenarios.recommended_pattern: Claude Code Agent SDK (max_budget_usd + readOnlyHint + acceptEdits/dontAsk)
scenarios.rationale_zh: Claude Agent SDK 原生提供跨子智能体累计的 max_budget_usd 与 max_turns 门禁，超限自动终止后台子智能体。
scenarios.rationale_en: Claude Agent SDK enforces cumulative max_budget_usd across parent and background subagents, halting active children on cap.

scenarios.domain_zh: 动态系统提示词更新与 KV Cache 保活
scenarios.domain_en: Dynamic System Prompt Update with KV Cache Preservation
scenarios.question_zh: 在多轮对话中途注入新的环境状态或技能提示，但严禁破坏首 Token 前缀导致 KV Cache 全量失效
scenarios.question_en: Inject updated runtime instructions mid-session without invalidating the KV cache prefix at message node 0
scenarios.rationale_zh: DSH 支持将动态变化的 system/message 以 in-history 模式追加在历史流尾部，保持前缀 94.2% KV Cache 命中率。
scenarios.rationale_en: DSH supports appending mid-session system/message updates in-history rather than mutating node 0, preserving 94.2% KV cache hits.

scenarios.domain_zh: 异构多引擎子智能体联邦编排
scenarios.question_zh: 由主控 Harness 统一调度进程内 Fork 子智能体、Claude Code 子智能体、Codex 与 ACP 协议外部智能体
scenarios.question_en: Coordinate in-process forked children, Claude Code SDK agents, Codex agents, and ACP remote agents under one parent
scenarios.rationale_zh: DSH packages/subagent 内置 spawn/fork/acp/claude-code/codex/dsh-sdk 七种 Provider，统一暴露 startActivation 契约。
scenarios.rationale_en: DSH packages/subagent ships 7 pluggable providers behind a unified startActivation and ContinuableCreateSpec contract.

scenarios.domain_zh: 百人研发团队 AI 工件合规与评测流水线
scenarios.domain_en: Enterprise Team AI Artifact Governance & Eval CI
scenarios.question_zh: 为百人工程团队分发标准化 Agent/Prompt/Instruction/Skill，并強制执行模型白名单、加密签名与行为等价评测
scenarios.question_en: Distribute standardized Agents/Prompts/Instructions/Skills with model allowlists, artifact signing, and behavior evals
scenarios.recommended_pattern: Microsoft HVE Core (Collections + Vally Eval Suite + Sign-PlannerArtifacts)
scenarios.rationale_zh: HVE Core 提供 14 个 Collection 清单、model-catalog.json 成本层级校验、Vally 行为评测与 Planner 工件签名门禁。
scenarios.rationale_en: HVE Core provides 14 collection manifests, model-catalog cost-tier linting, Vally behavior evals, and artifact signing gates.

scenarios.domain_zh: 共享任务板多智能体并行写冲突协调
scenarios.domain_en: Multi-Agent Shared DAG Task Board & Write-Scope Coordination
scenarios.question_zh: 多个平级智能体围绕同一复杂特性并行认领子任务，需无锁 CAS 版本控制、DAG 阻塞依赖与写目录范围声明
scenarios.question_en: Multiple peer agents claim tasks from a shared board with CAS revision control, acyclic blockedBy DAG, and writeScopes
scenarios.recommended_pattern: DeepSeek DSH (ctx.agentTeams TeamTaskSnapshot CAS + blockedBy DAG)
scenarios.rationale_zh: DSH ctx.agentTeams 实现带 CAS revision 的 TeamTaskSnapshot、无环 blockedBy 依赖图与声明式 writeScopes。
scenarios.rationale_en: DSH ctx.agentTeams implements CAS-versioned TeamTaskSnapshot records, acyclic blockedBy graphs, and advisory writeScopes.

scenarios.domain_zh: 海量 MCP 工具接入下的首轮上下文减负
scenarios.domain_en: Massive MCP Tool Catalog Context Deferral
scenarios.question_zh: 挂载 5+ 个企业 MCP Server（共 120+ 工具 Schema），需防止首轮请求被数万 Token 的工具定义塞满
scenarios.question_en: Mount 5+ enterprise MCP servers (120+ tool schemas) without bloating turn-1 prompt tokens with unused schemas
scenarios.recommended_pattern: Claude Code Agent SDK (MCP ToolSearch on-demand schema loading)
scenarios.rationale_zh: Claude Code 默认启用 MCP ToolSearch 按需延迟加载工具 Schema，仅将核心内建工具放入首轮固定前缀。
scenarios.rationale_en: Claude Code defers MCP tool schemas by default via ToolSearch, loading full JSON schemas on-demand only when needed.

scenarios.domain_zh: 高风险实施计划的对抗性红队质询
scenarios.question_zh: 在计划落盘后、代码合入前，自动执行结构化批判（PC-xxx 缺陷分类）与无暗示对抗式质询
scenarios.question_en: Run structured pre-implementation plan critique (PC-xxx taxonomy) and adversarial What/Why/How implementation interrogation
scenarios.rationale_zh: HVE 内置 rpi-plan-critique 子技能、零暗示对抗质询智能体 task-challenger 以及五视角人工门禁 code-review。
scenarios.rationale_en: HVE ships rpi-plan-critique (PC-xxx taxonomy), zero-hint adversarial task-challenger, and 5-perspective human-gated code-review.

scenarios.domain_zh: 无持久层直接对纯内存单会话硬套重量级三方消息总线
scenarios.domain_en: Anti-Pattern: Heavy External Broker for Single In-Memory CLI Loop
scenarios.question_zh: 反模式测试：在无需持久化、单次 3 步完结的轻量 CLI 脚本中强行引入分布式 Agent Team DAG 与外部存储
scenarios.question_en: Anti-pattern check: Forcing distributed Agent Team DAG + external persistence on a 3-turn ephemeral CLI script
scenarios.recommended_pattern: REJECT Over-Engineering -> Use dsh-sdk-minimal or Claude Code single-shot query()
scenarios.rationale_zh: 反模式告警 (✕)：3 步轻量任务无需挂载持久化与 Team DAG；应选 dsh-sdk-minimal (纯内存 Session) 或单次 query()。
scenarios.rationale_en: Anti-pattern alert (✕): 3-turn ephemeral tasks do not need persistence or Team DAG; use memory-only dsh-sdk-minimal or single query().

scenarios.domain_zh: 企业级混合架构：HVE SDLC 规范层 + DSH/Claude 运行时内核
scenarios.domain_en: Enterprise Reference Blueprint: HVE Governance + DSH/Claude Runtime
scenarios.question_zh: 作为 AI SA 设计企业级研发数字员工平台：如何同时获得 HVE 的 RPI 上下文隔离治理与 DSH/Claude 的微内核运行时能力？
scenarios.question_en: AI SA Enterprise Blueprint: Combine HVE's RPI context governance with DSH's Cordis seam microkernel & Claude Code execution
scenarios.recommended_pattern: Hybrid Layered Harness (Upper: HVE 4-Tier Artifacts & RPI / Lower: DSH Cordis + Claude Subagent)
scenarios.rationale_zh: 最佳实践：上层采用 HVE 四层工件与 RPI 阶段隔离规范，底层由 DSH Cordis 微内核挂载 subagent-claude-code 与远程沙箱 Provider。
scenarios.rationale_en: Best practice: Upper layer uses HVE 4-tier artifacts & RPI phase isolation; lower runtime uses DSH Cordis with subagent-claude-code & sandbox seams.
